summary: Research artifact analyzing web admin portal needs for enterprise scale (1000+ stores). Evaluates which roles need web access (Admin YES, Area Manager YES, Store Manager MAYBE, Auditor NO). Recommends Flutter Web as technology choice for code reuse. Proposes a responsive layout strategy: same Dart codebase, different scaffold for mobile vs web. Covers per-role web features, technology options (Flutter Web vs React vs Next.js), and a phased rollout approach.
